what_this_is: The manifest behind /experiments/. One experiment, one folder, one workflow, one visualisation — each with its own generator (or a shared engine driven by its own scenario.json, per brief v0.33.68), its own gates, and a bench entry carrying a does_not_prove. The hub page is generated from this file so the listing cannot drift from the folders.
rules: Every word derived at build time from the files the pipeline runs on; no typed counts.
Real and synthetic never blend — a surface is derived from real artefacts, or it carries the SYNTHETIC marker beside every value.
Every visual claim has a gate comparing the drawing to the declaration.
Genre, not work: a genre's conventions are for using; a specific game's art, names or wording are not.
Render it, screenshot it, read the screenshot before shipping.
